headline: The Huang rebound held to the close, but Williams gave no ground on a December hike and crude kept sliding

findings.headline: Williams keeps the December hike on the table
findings.body: In what CNBC calls the last major Fed speech before the 8–9 December meeting, New York Fed President Williams said there is "still work to do" on inflation and that getting back to 2% is "100% essential", pinning the pressure on the Iran conflict, AI build-out demand and tariffs. He did not address December directly, but he also gave no pushback against the quarter-point hike markets already fully price, which is not the softer tone Bessent and Ackman were lobbying for at the weekend. Earlier, the 2-year auction stopped through (4.700% vs 4.703% when-issued, bid-to-cover 2.65 from 2.59), so demand for the front end is there even with a hike priced.

findings.headline: Oil sold off on supply, not on growth fear
findings.body: Crude settled at its lowest since late August even on a strong risk-on day, as Middle East flows recovered and Libya's Sharara pipeline restarted, and weekend Gulf shipping and refinery attacks gave it no lift. JPMorgan now sees futures in the high $70s in the first half of 2027 on a surplus, so the market is trading the IEA's Q4 glut ahead of the OPEC+ meeting. That is why oil producers lagged while miners and tech led: the rebound was a growth-and-AI trade with energy left out.

sources.label: CNA/Reuters: Oil slumps to 3-month low on Middle East flows, Libyan restart

findings.headline: HPE shows the AI bar is high again, with PCE on Wednesday
findings.body: HPE beat on its fiscal fourth quarter and guided above estimates, yet the stock slipped after hours following a 17% jump in the session, a sign that today's AI rebound already paid for good news. Next tests are US consumer confidence and Dell's results on Tuesday, then a packed Wednesday with core PCE, the Q3 GDP revision and jobless claims before the Thanksgiving close. With thin holiday liquidity, a hot PCE print is the main risk to the bounce.

sources.label: Seeking Alpha: HPE falls even as Q4 results, guidance top estimates

view: Our view: the Huang reset fixed the AI sentiment problem, but Williams left the Fed's hike path intact, so the rally now depends on Wednesday's PCE; cheaper oil is the one tailwind for the inflation story the Fed is watching.
